infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Mesh Gemma tags incident reports with your location so peers can see where help is needed.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Mesh Gemma tags incident reports with your location so peers can see where help is needed.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Mesh Gemma uses Bluetooth to discover nearby peers when WiFi is unavailable.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Mesh Gemma advertises a Bluetooth peripheral so other phones can discover this node.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Mesh Gemma discovers other phones on your local network to sync the offline feed.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Mesh Gemma uses the camera so you can attach a photo of the disaster scene to an incident report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Mesh Gemma reads photos so you can attach an existing image of the disaster scene to an incident report.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow Mesh Gemma to connect to other devices via Bluetooth for mesh networking.
plugins.bluetoothPeripheralPermission: Allow Mesh Gemma to run as a Bluetooth peripheral.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Mesh Gemma tags incident reports with your location so peers can see where help is needed.

plugins.photosPermission: Mesh Gemma reads photos so you can attach an existing image of the disaster scene to an incident report.
plugins.cameraPermission: Mesh Gemma uses the camera so you can attach a photo of the disaster scene to an incident report.
